full_query: Is Augmentin the same thing as Amoxcicilin?
sentences: No, Augmentin is not the same thing as amoxicillin
Augmentin is a combination antibiotic that contains two active ingredients: amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium
Amoxicillin is a penicillin-type antibiotic that works by stopping the growth of bacteria
Clavulanate potassium is a beta-lactamase inhibitor that helps prevent certain bacteria from becoming resistant to amoxicillin
Amoxicillin, on the other hand, is a single antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin class and is used to treat a variety of bacterial infections
